review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form; encourage a substantially narrower and newly executed resubmission
blocking_findings: No distinct numerical advantage or capability of the explicit NBO actor is isolated against direct Bellman/HJB computation.
The only full continuous-domain economic certificate is one-dimensional and problem-specific.
All three final NDU NBO seeds miss the declared finite-model policy-regret target while every direct run passes.
The high-dimensional coupled experiment provides sampled residual diagnostics rather than value-accuracy or welfare certification, and two of three dimension-20 NBO runs fail.
The dynamic Cournot result is a finite-grid direct dynamic-programming calculation rather than evidence for a neural NBO solver.
The baseline study remains too narrow for an Econometrica numerical-method contribution.
The manuscript's breadth substantially exceeds the depth of its completed theorem-algorithm-evidence chain.
